//: The runner plan's map (scripts/delivery/area_select.py; ci.yml job `plan`). Edit it for this repository.
jobs: every job the plan can switch. always_jobs: run whatever changed (the static gates).
run_everything: a change under these runs every job. docs: a change under these runs no test.
areas: a changed path under `paths` runs the `jobs` of that area; `tests` are the area's test globs for tools that want them.
A path in none of the four lists runs everything (the safe default). A plain path also matches everything under it.
